name: Font dialog launcher
what_it_does: Opens the Font dialog — the consolidated surface for all character formatting plus advanced options (spacing, ligatures, defaults).
behavior: Opens Font (dialog). Contents (60 controls): RichEdit Control, Line up, Page down, Line down, RichEdit Control, Line up, Line down, RichEdit Control, Line up, Page down, Line down, Context help, Close, Font:, +Body, +Headings. Sub-surfaces: ui:font-dialog-text-effects. [the subfeature:font-dialog dialog — fully enumerated across 2 tab(s); option controls are endpoints] Appears as the small dialog-launcher arrow in the Font group's corner.
